entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We ought to tell everyone else that, too.[n]Let's all meet up after school.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Um... I'm sorry. I can't believe what I[n]tried to do to you two...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I genuinely cannot apologize enough[n]for what happened...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aw c'mon, there's no need for that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: More importantly, how have you been?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But, mentally? To be entirely honest,[n]I'm all mixed up.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: My memories are still pretty fuzzy and[n]I haven't really processed everything[n]yet...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry. I shouldn't bother you[n]with such things now.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm going to need a little time to myself[n]to think things through. I have to figure[n]out what to do with myself from here on...
